page.overview:
Who is Bokori Man?

In the English version of Street Fighter × Tekken, the show was renamed as Mighty Transforming Battle Warriors and Bokori Man is known as the Red Warrior Bokori Man, implying that the show is similar to Mighty Morphin Power Rangers.

In Street Fighter × Tekken, Sakura and Blanka think that Lars Alexandersson is Bokori Man. Also, if Ken wins a match against Lars, Ken asks if he is cosplaying as Bokori Man. One of Ken's alternate costumes is Bokori Man.

In one of Blanka's endings in Street Fighter V: Arcade Edition, Blanka and Sakura watch the Bokori Man show.
